_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (score rarely moves) plus cooler momentum/funding/MVRV and flat ETF flows mean no breaker is visible; stay on the Hope rung until a real impulse appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: both cautionary, but analyst explicitly HOLD/coil while narrative only supplies inflow pressure without a forward phase; no shared directional breaker
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~50-58, funding stays near flat, price drifts, and ETF flows/momentum remain impulse-free
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >63 with rising funding and ETF inflows (up toward Optimism) OR F&G <47 with exchange netflow spike and 30d momentum rollover (down toward Disbelief)
